stories.title: Plaid Cymru, SNP and Sinn Fein sign memorandum on independence and closer EU ties
stories.summary: Plaid Cymru has signed a new agreement with the SNP and Sinn Féin pledging closer cooperation on areas of shared interest, including renewable energy, the economy and strengthened relations with Europe. stories.title: Roadworks: what’s happening on Flintshire’s roads this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire and Deeside face a number of road closures and temporary traffic lights this week, with several new schemes starting. stories.title: Nine-bedroom holiday let approved for barns at Rhydymwyn farm
stories.summary: Redundant barns at a farm near Mold have been approved for conversion into a nine-bedroom holiday let. Flintshire County Council’s planning committee approved the application for Tyddyn Y Gwynt Farm, Rhydymwyn, on 11 September. The application was submitted by agents Paterson Macaulay & Owens Ltd.
